scope: One local content-quality review and repair round on PR 222. Automated checks identify structural defects and review candidates; they do not determine Google AdSense approval, originality or financial accuracy.

repairs.change: Removed contradictory monthly-tax-input and CTC-breakdown claims, consolidated overlapping explanations and added a reproducible worked example.
repairs.example: Rs 12 lakh CTC, 50% basic, 12% PF, employer PF included, FY 2026-27 new regime, Rs 200 monthly professional tax and no other deductions gives Rs 87,800 monthly net in the supported model.

repairs.change: Explained the finite annual-annuity model, disclosed its 1% floor for assumed real returns, corrected the worked example and labelled required SIP as an additional monthly SIP. Formula behavior was preserved.
Disclosed that the model adds stages using original later-debt balances rather than simulating ongoing minimum payments. Added a reproducible numerical example. Formula behavior was preserved.
Added a reproduced fee-drag example and removed a duplicate FAQ. Equal-fee and example regressions passed.
Corrected outdated bank-interest TDS thresholds, bank-wise aggregation and declaration conditions; distinguished withholding from tax liability. Added exact official references.

Separated FEMA and tax residency, corrected NR/RNOR Schedule FA exclusions, separated remittance routes and qualified certificate/current-form requirements. Removed a duplicate summary and unsupported reviewer attribution.

repairs.area: Five existing blogs and ITR chart
repairs.change: Corrected ITR-1 exceptions, related capital-gains wording, outdated PMAY claims and unsupported EPF eligibility/tax/document assertions. EPFO reform announcements are distinguished from operative provisions; unverified current limits are not certified.

Exposed officialSources on every blog that configures them, labelled the shared disclaimer honestly and replaced unsupported blanket research/review claims in shared schema. Existing full-review dates were preserved.

Translated revised content and fixed corrupted Hindi Pre-EMI text. Added a regression detector for translated batch markers. Catalog coverage is an automated completeness check, not native editorial signoff.

Fixed six white content-card wrappers that inherited near-white text in dark mode, making educational, example, related, methodology and FAQ headings readable. Added dark-theme colors for the calculator title and introduction; browser verification confirmed the title renders white in dark mode. Copy was preserved.

Aligned calculator/blog inventories with active pages, removed mandatory length/FAQ-count heuristics and made rendered locale checks honor noindex in HTTP headers as well as meta tags. Added a review flag for examples without concrete numbers.

googlePolicyCrossCheck.method: Read current official Google help/policy pages, opened the inventory-value guidance in the in-app Browser and inspected source plus local HTML. This is not an AdSense account Policy Center result or an approval certificate.
googlePolicyCrossCheck.inventoryValue: Worked examples, model limitations and original calculators add reader value; content quantity and passing automated structure checks do not certify originality or approval. Existing human/native review remains incomplete.
googlePolicyCrossCheck.manualPlacements: One labeled, configured placement per microtool after article content. Salary-page HTML contained zero manual ad units; live Auto ads density was not verified.
googlePolicyCrossCheck.privacyAndAdsTxt: Advertising cookie/data disclosures and Google partner-data links are present. Local ads.txt returned HTTP 200 and matches the shared script publisher ID.
googlePolicyCrossCheck.autoAds: The AdSense script is loaded globally, including confirmation/error screens and noindex translations. Script presence alone does not prove ads are served. Verify account Auto ads exclusions or route eligibility before serving ads on navigation, alert/error or unreviewed screens; noindex does not restrict AdSense serving.
googlePolicyCrossCheck.consent: No local CMP/TCF or ad-consent gating was found. An account-configured Google message may exist. Verify the certified TCF CMP requirement if serving personalized ads to EEA, UK or Switzerland visitors, and applicable cookie/data consent. Traffic regions, account messages and live consent behavior remain unverified.
googlePolicyCrossCheck.accountAccess: The AdSense dashboard returned Access denied for the signed-in Google account. Account policy issues, site-review status, Auto ads exclusions and account consent messages could not be inspected.
